tagline.en: A diffusion-transformer robot policy that predicts unified actions from vision and language.
tagline.zh: 一个扩散 Transformer 机器人策略,从视觉与语言预测统一动作。

en: RDT-1B is the Robotics Diffusion Transformer, a vision-language-action policy from THU-ML. It takes camera views and a language instruction and generates robot actions in a unified action space, using a diffusion transformer trained for bimanual manipulation.

The policy pairs a SigLIP vision encoder with a T5-XXL text encoder to read the scene and the instruction, then denoises action sequences with a DPM sampler. In WorldFoundry it runs with two-frame, three-camera preprocessing; you can also feed precomputed text embeddings to lower peak memory.
The released weights are a pretraining checkpoint, so most deployments fine-tune it on the target robot and task before use.
zh: RDT-1B 是 Robotics Diffusion Transformer,由 THU-ML 推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略。它接收相机画面与一条语言指令,在统一动作空间中生成机器人动作,底层是为双臂操作训练的扩散 Transformer。
该策略用 SigLIP 视觉编码器配合 T5-XXL 文本编码器来理解画面与指令,再用 DPM 采样器对动作序列去噪。在 WorldFoundry 中,它以双帧、三相机的预处理方式运行;你也可以传入预先算好的文本 embedding 来降低显存峰值。
发布的权重是预训练 checkpoint,因此多数部署会先在目标机器人与任务上做微调再使用。

whenToUse.en: When you need a language-conditioned manipulation policy to fine-tune on your own robot — especially bimanual tasks where a strong diffusion-transformer base helps.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个语言条件的操作策略、并要在自己的机器人上微调时——尤其是双臂任务,一个强扩散 Transformer 底座会很有帮助。

notFor.en: Not a plug-and-play policy: the released checkpoint is a pretraining base and typically needs task fine-tuning. It also depends on separate SigLIP and T5 encoders, which must be downloaded.
notFor.zh: 它不是即插即用的策略:发布的 checkpoint 是预训练底座,通常需要针对任务微调。它还依赖单独的 SigLIP 与 T5 编码器,需要下载。

en: Diffusion-transformer VLA policy for bimanual manipulation
SigLIP vision + T5-XXL text encoders, DPM action sampling
Two-frame, three-camera input; accepts precomputed embeddings
Released as a pretraining checkpoint for downstream fine-tuning
zh: 面向双臂操作的扩散 Transformer VLA 策略
SigLIP 视觉 + T5-XXL 文本编码器,DPM 动作采样
双帧、三相机输入;可接受预算好的 embedding
以预训练 checkpoint 发布,便于下游微调
